run_signaling_experiment: run the signaling marketplace experiment with configurable agents, days, and LLM provider
configure_llm_provider: configure the language model provider using --api_type and --model_name flags
set_experimental_condition: set the experimental condition to social, asocial, or asocial_personal
export_marketplace_logs: export marketplace logs as HTML and JSON files for each simulated day
export_trade_and_price_history: export trade history and price history as JSON files to /tmp
